Wheel channels and fallback channels are matched as 'the name contains
this fragment', case-insensitive. List order = priority.
A GPS/IMU reporting its velocity vector as components. Matching happens
on the name SUFFIX, and whatever precedes it is treated as the receiver
name — which is how two receivers in a single log are told apart
automatically so their readings can be averaged.
_about_scalar: Fallback when no components exist: a single GPS speed channel. The name
must contain ALL of 'scalar_requires' and NONE of 'scalar_excludes'
